method: Side-by-side app-local releases on the same MuMu 12 device. Inspect the original screenshots and measure dark hair pixels in x 277–314, y 165–177 of their 432×768 images. The normal single portrait starts below this region, while the additional larger head reaches the clipped stage top. Classify only visible stage frames; a covered/exiting keyboard panel is not a model observation.
previous_release_result: The two head silhouettes were visible at cold display and still present 17 seconds after returning from OS settings. This predates the page-owned microphone navigation.
current_result: Current remained single for 17 seconds after a direct Settings round trip and for 26 seconds after Send. A repeated positive-height IME run also remained single at 2, 5, 10, 17 and 26 seconds after Send. A separate current run has a double portrait at approximately 4.75 seconds. A guaranteed recovery time is not inferable.
